title: Automated Isn't the Same as Correct
description: Design an independent accuracy check for an AI-assisted workflow that doesn't just trust the system's own success metric — an automation-rate number and a correctness number are different axes, and a report with only one of them is unfinished.

title: What Was True at Launch Doesn't Stay True
description: Set up monitoring that catches an AI-assisted workflow drifting after launch — model drift and data drift, real production signals, thresholds that trigger a review instead of noise, and a cadence and named owner that survive past the engagement.

title: The Number the Client Actually Needs
description: Calculate an honest ROI figure for an AI-assisted workflow, accounting for the costs a vendor pitch leaves out — the difference between time saved and money saved, hidden review and setup costs, a calculation that survives a skeptical CFO, and the discipline to say so when the honest number is negative.
